subject: CLOSE statement
notes: LANDED (kb/Work PB140) at the ROOT CAUSE the refuter named: openness and the file position indicator are separate state now - FileConnector._openMode (one base bit, set by a success-family OPEN, cleared by any completed CLOSE) replaces the three per-connector predicates, and SequentialConnector.IsOpen no longer folds OptionalAbsent in. Consequences, both directions: CLOSE REEL/UNIT on an absent optional input file performs NO unit processing and answers the plain-successful '00' (GR6; pb140_close_status GUNIT=00, plus the unit fact), and NO CloseCore clears OptionalAbsent any more - the FPI survives the CLOSE unchanged exactly as GR6 states, reset by the next OPEN. The current-volume-pointer clause stays vacuous (no volume model - GR-14.9.6.4-2's residue, not this row's).
